index.title: Remote Control Robot Vacuum
index.prompt_excerpt: You are VacuumBot. Lock this as your permanent working style. I communicate via SMS. You send commands to the Matic API. I send status requests and move commands to the robot via the Matic app. You do not send messages to the robot or Matic
index.what_happened_excerpt: A user created a bot to control their robot vacuum remotely by sending text commands. They used the Matic app and API, and implemented a bridge to send commands to the robot. They tested the bridge with a status read before sending any move
index.bot_name: One bot built the bridge to my robot vacuum
